articleTitle: Pre-processing of Froth Image of Coal Flotation Based on Weighted Fuzzy C-Mean Clustering by One-Dimensional Histogram
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Weighted Fuzzy C-Mean clustering algorithm by one-dimensional histogram can classify accurately pixels of coal flotation froth images into three kinds such as bubble vertex, the bubble surface and the background to increase the contrast of bubble edge and background, accurately positioning the bubble region for its fast convergence speed, real-time characteristics. After de-noised based on morphological filtering method of reconstruction opening and closing, clustered image can not only remove noises but retain more image detail and reflect accurately the true image information. So over-segmentation and under-segmentation will be avoided so as to be segmented more accurate when image clustered by these algorithms is processed using watershed segmentation based tags.

Author Keywords: Weighted Fuzzy C-Mean clustering algorithm by one-dimensional histogra

articleTitle: Determined the Optimum Relaxation Parameter for the 7-point Laplacian
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: The SOR iteration method for solving linear systems of equations depends upon a relaxation parameter. A well-known theory for determining the relaxation parameter was given by Young for consistently ordered matrices. In this paper, we prove that the matrix of the linear system arisen from the 7-point Laplacian is consistently ordered in both point form and block form. Then by separating variables and solving difference equations, the optimum relaxation parameters of point and block SOR iterations for the system are given for the first time, respectively.

articleTitle: Approximate Packet Classification and Stateful Rule DFA for Cloud Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: This paper propose a new intrusion detection system architecture, which can be used by cloud intrusion detection. Our new architecture uses the inaccurate hashing to obtain a fast packet inspection and applies a new stateful rule DFA to track session inspection process. After a preliminary analysis, the new architecture should be feasible in the real application.

articleTitle: Design Miniature Telementering Blast-Off Machine According to the FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Telemetry miniature transmitter is the sensing device, a major part, of the Internet of things. The design of the telemetry miniature transmitter according to FPGA not only has the characters of high integration, strong calculation and low power consumption, but also features high agility and strong actual effect. According to the overall system requirements, the design method and process for FPGA circuit is established, and its system circuit test proves that it meets the actual requirement. The target communication parameters are conveniently allocated through the configuration circuit, which can be upgraded through software upgrade. The target identity can be easily recognized. It is applicable to the common use.

articleTitle: Electro-hydraulic Control System for Hydraulic Supports: About the Study on Solenoid Valve Driver
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: This paper demonstrates an example of the solenoid valve driver cored on AVR micro controller. With a discussion over the system's hardware architecture, we further explain the communication protocol between the module and system controller, as well as the corresponding software control process. Besides, we illustrate the reliability and flexibility of our design in both the software and hardware phases. The driver module has proved effective and satisfying in practices on related projects.

articleTitle: Research on the New Technologies of In-situ Automatic Ice Thickness Observation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Ice thickness is one of the most critical physical indicators in the ice science and ice engineering research, and it is very necessary to research the in-situ automatic observation technologies of the ice thickness. This paper has introduced the principle of three new technologies of in-situ sea ice thickness automatic observation and provided the findings of its in-situ or laboratory application study. Such three new technologies of ice thickness observation can meet different needs of fixed-point ice thickness observation and realize the simultaneous measurement in order to accurately judge the ice thickness.

articleTitle: A Novel Classifier Based on Nearest Feature Line
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: In this paper, a novel classifier based nearest feature line, called as restricted nearest feature line with angle, is proposed. NFL was originally used in face recognition, and later began to be used in many other applications. Though successful in improving the classification ability, there are still some drawbacks in NFL that limit their further application in practice. To improve the miss-classification of nearest feature line when the prototypes in NFL are far away from the query sample, restricted nearest feature line with angle uses the angle between two lines to restrict the feature lines. The two lines are composed by query sample and both prototype samples. A large number of experiments are executed on ORL and AR face database. And detailed comparison result is given.

articleTitle: Generation of Optimal Homogenous Strips Patterns for the Two-Dimensional Cutting Problem
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: An algorithm is proposed for generating patterns of rectangular items based on homogenous strips (RIBTHS). It divides the plate into four regions. Each region contains homogenous strips of the same direction and length. An enumeration method is used to determine the positions of the three partition lines. The knapsack algorithm is used to obtain the optimal layout of the strips in each region. The combination of the regions that has the maximum value is selected as the optimal solution. The procedure is combined with the linear programming approach to form the algorithm for generating the cutting plans of large scale cutting stock problems. The algorithm was tested using lots of benchmark instances reported in the literature. The results indicate that the algorithm is efficient both in improving material usage and simplifing the cutting process.

articleTitle: The Improvment of Text Feature Selection Method Based on Key Words
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Vector space model is commonly used in the formal representation on text, but this approach would not highlight the features which play a key role in the text contents. An improved feature selection method based on key words was proposed, which uses text structural information and mutual information theory to extract key words on text content. Through using support vector machine (SVM) classifier to test, results showed that classification accuracy has improved significantly.

articleTitle: Causal Connectivity Brain Network: A Novel Method of Motor Imagery Classification for Brain-Computer Interface Applications
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: The effective connectivity among overlapped core regions recruited by motor imagery (MI) was explored by means of Granger causality and graph-theoretic method, based on Electroencephalography (EEG) data. In this paper, causal connectivity brain network (CCBN) was proposed for the classification of motor imagery for brain¨Ccomputer interface applications, by means of source analysis of scalp-recorded EEGs and effective connectivity networks. A classification rate of about 90% was achieved in the human subject studied using both the equivalent dipole analysis and the granger causality analysis. The present promising results suggest that the CCBN could manifest a clearer picture on the cortical activity and explore the causal relation among the independent sources, and thus facilitate the classification of MI tasks from scalp EEGs for brain-computer interface (BCI).

articleTitle: Ellipsoid Earth Path Planning Based on Shortest Tangent Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Due to the difference of path planning on the plane and real circumstances, the path planning on ellipsoid earth was adopted. The basic principle of shortest tangent method was analyzed. The path planning model of ellipsoid earth based on shortest tangent method was built. The steps and processes of model building are discussed. The results of simulation shows that the path planning method which is based on shortest tangent method on the ellipsoid earth can avoid the threat fleetly and availably.

articleTitle: The Uncertainty Analysis and Verification of the PG7607 Gas Piston Pressure Gauge
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: The uncertainty analysis of the PG7607 gas piston pressure gauge is taken in the gauge mode in this paper. The obtained result of the PG7607 gas piston pressure gauge uncertainty is 7.5ppm. Based on the PG7607 gas piston pressure gauge uncertainty analysis, test had been taken for verifying the uncertainty result of PG7607 with comparison method to primary standard, the analysis result is confirmed by the test.

articleTitle: A Tuning Scheme for Parameters of Generalized Predictive Controller Based on Mind Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: This paper presents a scheme that the Mind Evolutionary Algorithm (MEA) tunes adaptively parameters of the generalized predictive controller. The value domain of parameters constitutes the solution space of MEA. The cost function of Generalized Predictive Control (GPC), the maximum value of the system output and its decay speed constitute the fitness function of MEA. During the control process, MEA adjusts constantly parameters so that the rapidity and robustness of GPC can be improved. Optimum experiments and simulation experiments show the scheme effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Automatic 3D Vessel Trees Matching in Thoracic CT Scans
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: In order to study ventilation or to extract other functional information of the lungs, intra-patient volume registration of scans at different time instances is valuable as an examination tool. Volume registration is fundamental to multiple medical imaging algorithms. Specially, non-rigid registration of thoracic CT scans taken at different time instances can be used to detect new nodules more reliably and assess the growth rate of existing nodules. In this work, an automatic 3D DFS-based method for vessel trees matching is proposed as an independent registration method. As a proof of concept of this automatic matching, the method is applied to match vessel trees in lung volume at different time instances. First of all, some proper related works are implemented for later use. Based on the automatic 3D DFS, each vessel tree is then intrinsically represented by Euclidean distance. Finally, both bifurcations and geodesic distance between two branch points are robustly matched.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Analysis of Foundation Pit
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: This paper introduces the purpose, items and basic requirements of the deformation measure of foundation pit. Expatiate the observation point setting, measure method, frequency and alarming value of the displacement measurement of the top Retaining structure of foundation pit from the actual conditions.

articleTitle: The Research of the Knowledge Based on Autonomic Database
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: With auto-learning strategy and expression mode of production, the foregone workload records which are produced by automatic workload-adaptive system are recorded in knowledge base. The best control scheme is achieved by calculating the workload's similarity in knowledge base when the new workload is produced. Simulation results show that the method can effectively improve the efficiency of the workload control.

articleTitle: A Water Area Detective System Based on Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Traditional water pollution detective methods are time-consuming and complex. Therefore a new detecting method using the wireless sensor networks for detecting water pollution is proposed. In this system a kind of double cluster-head topology control algorithm of wireless sensor networks is proposed. This algorithm selects main cluster-head (MCH) by calculating weighting-value and collects data by main cluster-head, but transfers data by assistant cluster-head (ACH). The simulated experiment results show this algorithm can reduce cluster-head's energy consumption, balance the network load, and prolong the network's lifetime.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of Storage Method of Data Mining Results Based on XML Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Data mining plays an important position in enterprise decision support systems, it can provide very important information for decision-making. In this paper, with a result of storage systems, data mining architecture, this architecture can accelerate the speed of data mining, in order to effectively improve the efficiency of the system decision-making. Based on the Storage method presents in this paper about the data mining results, this paper designs a simulation of the mining results, storage systems, storing and query results, verify the feasibility and correctness of this method of mining results stored on five mining.

articleTitle: A Lossless Characteristic Compression Method for Continuous Arterial Pulse Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Arterial blood pressure is one of the important biomedical waveforms that possess lots of important clinical and pathological information. This paper aims in designing a technique, which is called characteristic compression method, to perform almost loss less data compression for the continuous arterial blood pressure waveforms. This method uses the spline function to interpolate the original waveform at preselected sample points first. A fourth order spline function is considered with associated formulas in describing the coefficients of the function. A second stage compression is accompanied by using 12-bit digital data representation to store sample points and coefficients for each interval. Numerical simulation confirms that the proposed technique is feasible and does provide a very high compression rate and almost loss less reconstruction for the continuous arterial pulse wave.

articleTitle: The Research of Electronic Seal System Based on Digital Watermark Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: In order to avoid forgery problem used in the traditional seal and meet the security requirement of the digital documents, a watermark scheme against counterfeit for signature image is proposed. Watermark embedded in the seal image can improve the seal security, prevent the secret document from the illegal modification and realizes the function of identity authentication and non-repudiation.

articleTitle: Network Security Admission Solution Based on IEEE802.1X
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: With the rapid development and wide application of information technologies, enterprise network security is particularly important. IEEE802.1x standard is now widely used in the industry for a secure access technologies, this article on 802.1X agreed principles and certification process for analysis and presentations, and combined with access to Symantec's security technology, fast, secure and reliable Internet access environment.

articleTitle: A Sequential Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Algorithm in Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Spectrum sensing is an essential functionality for cognitive radio to improve the utilization ratio of the spectrum. Eigenvalue detector is a promising candidate for spectrum sensing in cognitive radio. However, it requires very long detection time, which leads to inefficient spectrum utilization. In this paper, we propose a new cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm by applying sequential detection framework to the eigenvalues detector to reduce the detection time. We derive the threshold of the proposed spectrum sensing algorithm based on the random matrix theory. Theoretical analysis and simulations results show that the proposed scheme outperforms the classical energy detection scheme.

articleTitle: Delayed and Non-delayed Coverage-Enhancing Algorithm for Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Wireless multimedia sensor networks (WMSNs) differ from the traditional wireless sensor networks (WSNs) due to their characteristics of directivity and turnable. However, as for the existing research on coverage of wireless multimedia sensor networks, sense models were built without taking the whole possible sense area into consideration. Aiming at different application needs, the authors present a classification taxonomy, in which these applications are fallen into two categories: delayed coverage and non-delayed coverage, and then defines an coverage-enhancing algorithm for wireless multimedia sensor networks (DNDCEA) by introducing the model of virtual centripetal force. Redundant sensors are shut off and coverage of networks can be enhanced by re-deploy sensors under the repel force based virtual centripetal force although large numbers of redundant sensors are shut off. Simulation results are presented for demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Recent Development of Silicon Nanowire FET Biosensor for DNA Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: Recently biosensors based on silicon nanowire field-effect transistors (SiNW-FETs) have drawn huge amounts of attention, due to their ultra sensitivity, selectivity, label-free and real-time detection abilities. As people know more and more knowledge of the structure and function of nucleic acid molecules, DNA detection has gained importance increasingly. Here, we briefly summarize major fabrication methods in synthesising SiNW-FETs and selectively describe some applications of SiNW-FET biosensors in DNA detection over the past few years. Some key results from each article are summarized, involving the concept and mechanism behind each sensor, with the aim of stimulating more efforts in developing SiNW-FET biosensors for detecting DNA.

articleTitle: SIP Steganalysis Using Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: The Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) is an IETF-defined signaling protocol widely used for controlling communication sessions such as voice and video calls over Internet Protocol (IP). With wide applications of SIP, hiding secret data in some SIP header fields becomes a potential threat to many applications using SIP. In this paper, chaos theory is applied to analyze normal SIP traffic and a feature model is proposed to detect hidden data in some SIP header fields. Experimental results show that the proposed method has average 91.9% detection rate and the computational complexity is low which makes this method appropriate for online mode.

articleTitle: Performance Comprehensive Evaluation of Large Enterprise Information System Based on the BSC
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computing, Measurement, Control and Sensor Network
abstract: This paper sets up a performance evaluation index system, based on the balanced scorecard for large enterprise information system within the context of large nuclear power company and determines the weight coefficient of the index system by using Delphi method and the analytic hierarchy process. Then it constructs a performance comprehensive evaluation model for the enterprise information systems based on fuzzy mathematics theory and grey theory whereby the performance level of experience information systems of a large power group is analyzed. Some problems are discovered and discussed, followed by corresponding countermeasures and strategies.
